model: K5 Eulerian correlation moments under the alpha=3/2 normalized-stable R probability
backend: Installed GMP 6.3.0 mpz_class; independent includeable graph-moment engine and checkpoint runner. No fixed-width moment or factorial arithmetic.
independent_exact_crosschecks: single_edge_26 against ordinary rational Taylor inversion of 2/[(1-z)^(3/4)+(1+z)^(3/4)]
triangle_18 against independent four-group rational multivariate Stieltjes inversion, with three correlation variables and no graph canonicalization
checkpoint_trial: First run the same three requests with max_new_moments=10 and a 120-second deadline, save completed submoments, append one incomplete journal fragment, then resume with the same source fingerprint and requests. Do not discard a 120-second checkpoint; continue it if necessary.
allowed_scale_checks: Exact stars-and-bars W22 count, integer partitions for spatial degree<=23/max coordinate<=12, and Bernstein grid size 13^4. No complete space expansion or old 3389-moment/2401-Bernstein replay.
artifact_policy: Binary, request files, journal and raw run files are outside all Git repositories; archive only sources, this registration, compact final results and proof report.
scope: This is a backend/recovery pilot, not a complete degree26 spatial certificate, a new g, or a C5 claim. No MATLAB session is used.
